how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_016.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.haze.descript: Wrap yourself in a cloak of aura concealing yourself from even the most heightened of senses.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.healer.descri: Mend wounds with a touch or unleash devastating afflictions, capable of both salvation and suffering.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.healing.descr: Heal a living being on a low level.
Call forth a rain of healing in a wide radius.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.healthcare.de: Boost the caster's health and saturation.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.heat_resistan: Ignore weaker heat-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger heat sources.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.heat_wave.des: Shoot a fiery projectile or summon a short-ranged fire storm which will damage all nearby entities.
Project your otherworldly gaze to see all nearby entities and partially ignore dodging abilities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.heavy_slash.d: Channel your aura into your arms and bring down a mountain-splitting slash.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.hellfire.desc: Summon a sphere of hellfire to deal massive damage in a small area.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.hero_haki.des: Use your Hero Aura to inspire your allies and terrify your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.holy_attack_r: Ignore weaker holy attacks or reduce the damage from stronger divine powers.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.hydraulic_pro: Propel yourself at high speeds underwater.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.hypnos.descri: Put even the strongest entities into sleep.
Create a powerful storm of snow to freeze your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ice_breaker.d: Shoot a giant icicle spear toward targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ice_breath.de: Spew icy breath to freeze enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ice_wall.desc: Call forth walls of ice upon targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.icicle_rain.d: Strike targets with a barrage of icicle lances from the sky.
Strike targets with a giant icicle spike from the ground.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.infinite_rege: Use your massive amount of magicule to instantly regenerate from all but the most grievous of injuries.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.infinity_pris: Trap enemies in an unbreakable dimensional cage or shield yourself from any threat with your dimensional barrier. Gain access to spatial storage.
Gather your aura at your feet to travel faster than the eye can see.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.invisible.des: Turn the caster invisible to hide from targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.law_manipulat: Bypass many restrictions by manipulating the law of the world.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.light.descrip: Summons a temporary light to block out the darkness.
